summary: 10 OpenSpec changes ordered so upstream sync lands first (provably conflict-free today) and userData is pinned before the app rename (otherwise profiles are silently orphaned). Three decisions taken: start-clean with no migration, a separate branding module rather than CHERRY_EDITION, and the updater deliberately not repointed because the-boss.know-me.tools has no release feed.
warnings: Adversarial vet widened scope: hardcoded 'CherryStudio' appears in 15 non-test files under src/main, including OAuth client name shown on third-party consent screens. Change rebrand-0075 added to cover them.
65 test files assert the Cherry brand and will break during rebrand-006; apply the no-behavior-pinning rule rather than mechanically re-greening.
Two decisions remain open and must not be guessed during execution: telemetry destination, and remove-vs-rebrand for the built-in Cherry support agents.
Hooks subsystem unavailable (KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT unset); plan:before/after were NOT fired and stage-gate.sh was unavailable, so the gate took the legacy warn-and-pass path.
